summary: iter138 typeahead-bindings + visual unification long-tail validation. All 11 new backend tests in test_iter138_typeahead_bindings.py pass (26/26 total combined with iter137 regression). CorrectiveAction create with equipment_master_id+employee_master_id persists both fields and GET confirms; PATCH preserves bindings on unrelated-field updates and accepts updates to the binding fields. FireExtinguisher create with equipment_master_id persists (confirmed via list GET, since per-id GET is 405 — list endpoint is the only read). Also confirmed FE create without binding still works (equipment_master_id defaults to ''). TrainingRecord create without explicit employee_master_id correctly defaults to employee_id (matches agent context); explicit employee_master_id overrides. /api/master-lookup/audit response shape includes corrective_actions in equipment_coverage. minor.issue: Per-id GET returns 405 Method Not Allowed; only list endpoint is exposed. Not a regression (pre-existed), but noted because it limits per-id verification in tests.

action_items: (Carryover from iter137 — also confirmed still missing) Wire the typeahead into the public Incidents create form (Safety Forms portal) so equipment_master_id/employee_master_id is captured at submission time, not via post-hoc backfill.

(Optional) Add a GET /api/safety/fire-extinguishers/{id} per-id detail endpoint for parity with corrective-actions; currently only the list endpoint is exposed and the model would benefit from this for direct deep-linking & test isolation.
critical_code_review_comments: TrainingRecord employee_master_id default to employee_id is convenient but is a silent fallback — if employee_id is a legacy free-text string (e.g. 'Mike J') it will land in employee_master_id and quietly poison coverage metrics. Consider validating against employees_master.id existence before defaulting, or emitting a 'master_link_method':'auto-default'|'explicit-pick' flag for audit traceability.

FireExtinguishers persist equipment_master_id only on CREATE (per the route in fire_extinguishers.py line 57) — the FireExtinguisherUpdate model accepts the field but the update handler should be audited to confirm it also $sets the field on PATCH (worth a follow-up test next iter).

MasterLookupCombobox testIdPrefix pattern is clean and matches existing portal conventions — the freetext 'Use exactly' option correctly renders with a distinct testid so UI tests can distinguish it from the master-pick path.

CA write endpoints (POST/PATCH/DELETE) reject admin tokens — this is correct per the multi-portal scope rules. The iter138 test had to mint a real safety token via /api/safety/login for the create/patch paths; admin-only conftest token would have produced 401.

context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iter138_typeahead_bindings.py is the regression suite for the typeahead-binding wiring. Two key gotchas baked in: (1) FireExtinguisher payload requires unit_id + location_kind (not tag_number/location), so don't rename them; (2) TrainingRecord uses completed_date (not completion_date). The MasterLookupCombobox testid pattern is `${testIdPrefix}-input`, `-dropdown`, `-item-{id}`, `-bound`, `-freetext`, `-clear` — use these in any follow-up FE test.
